summary: Engrim is an in‑memory SQLite‑compatible engine aimed at local‑first AI command‑line interfaces. It runs as a Python package (v1.3.0) and offers CLI, Python API, and Node.js SDK integrations. Developers building AI CLIs that need fast, temporary storage without cloud dependencies will find it useful. The strongest point is its lightweight design praised in HN comments, while the main drawback is that its test suite shows zero passed tests, indicating reliability concerns.
